A '''stun serum''' was a type of [[Poison/Legends|toxin]]. Stun serums could be applied to [[Dart/Legends|darts]], allowing it to be directed against a target using a [[dart shooter]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
